title: Auth Control Plane membership list (v1 wire format)
description: The memberships of one organization, as membership-read.v1 items. The list is PAGED by a keyset cursor on the item id: a response holds at most 100 items, in ascending id order, and when more remain an opaque `next_cursor` the caller sends back. The LAST page omits `next_cursor`: absent is the only form of 'no more pages', never null or empty. A page with no items has no cursor. The schema cannot compare items, so the Go parser (ParseReadResponse) refuses an out-of-order page, a repeated id, an item the request did not ask for, a cursor that is not the last item's, and a page over the requested limit.

schema_version.description: Contract identifier. A reader MUST reject an unrecognised value (G-26: unknown denies).

next_cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor; absent on the last page.
